Subject: Payment on hold (INV-8853): VAT docs attached

Hi Mina,

We ran into a payment hold on invoice INV-8853. Our AP team flagged that Redwood's billing entity on the invoice appears to be missing a VAT registration number for the EU country of supply and they want confirmation that the reverse-charge can be applied.

I've attached our VAT certificate and the invoice PDF for reference (attachments: Clearchain_VAT_cert_2026.pdf, INV-8853.pdf). We can sign a self-billing / reverse-charge acknowledgement if that helps. Our deadline to clear the month-end run is next Tuesday — can you confirm what you need from us to release payment?

Thanks,
Marta Novak
Finance Manager
Clearchain

Subject: Re: Payment on hold (INV-8853): VAT docs attached

Hi Marta — thanks for sending the certificate and invoice. I reviewed the files and started a VIES check on the VAT number you provided; there are two small discrepancies in the address line that the EU AP team sometimes flags. To unblock quickly we need two things from Clearchain:

1) A current company registration extract (official company registry PDF) that matches the VAT holder name exactly.
2) A short signed self-billing / reverse-charge acknowledgement (one-page) confirming Clearchain is the recipient for reverse-charge and that they accept the RC treatment for this supply.

I've attached a one-page template you can sign and return (see RC_evidence_template.xlsx, tab "Acknowledgement"). If you sign that and upload the registry extract we can:
- Complete our VIES/name reconciliation (usually same day)
- Re-issue a corrected invoice with the reverse-charge wording and our billing entity VAT shown in the correct field
- Mark the invoice as "release pending verification" in our billing system so AP can include it in the next run

If signing is difficult, we can accept a DocuSign link as an alternative — I can send DocuSign if you prefer. Also copying our accounting lead (Mina) and tax ops (Neha) so they can confirm no extra holdups.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Billing & Tax Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the quick response earlier in the week and for the VAT cert. To make sure we clear AP's hold before your month-end run (you said next Tuesday), here's what we'll do and the timeline:

What we need from Clearchain (please send by end of day Thursday, 9 Dec):
- Company registration extract (official registry PDF) that exactly matches the VAT holder name on the certificate
- Signed reverse-charge/self-billing acknowledgement (you can sign the attached template or I can send a DocuSign link)

What Redwood will do after we receive those items:
- Kim will complete VIES/name reconciliation and confirm within 24 hours
- We will re-issue INV-8853 with explicit reverse-charge wording and our billing VAT shown in the proper field
- Accounting will tag the invoice for immediate payment release on your next run (expected within 48 hours of validation)

If anything fails the VIES/name check we will raise one follow-up question (e.g., name variant) but we will work with your AP to avoid a full rework. I am copying our tax ops and accounting leads so nothing is missed.

Marta — if you want the DocuSign link, reply with the best signee name/email and I will send right away.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Director, Revenue Operations
